description: Creates a new project from a template (see planitude_list_templates) with its phases, tasks, durations and dependencies; dates are calculated from startDate on a Mon-Fri calendar. The result is a normal project that the other tools can edit. Calling it twice creates two projects. Requires write permission.

key.description: Project key (2-10 letters/digits, starting with a letter, e.g. 'Cronos'): tasks are numbered Cronos-1, Cronos-2, ... Fixed once the first task exists. Omitted = derived from the name.

locale.description: Language of task names. Default en.

name.description: Project name. Default: the template name.

templateId.description: Template id, e.g. 'builtin:website-launch' or a uuid.

tz.description: IANA time zone of the calendar, e.g. Europe/Rome. Default Europe/Rome.

name: planitude_create_project_from_template
title: Create project from template
